name: Failure handling, retry and rework
summary: What happens when processing fails or a result is rejected: final failure states, ML escalation, cancelling, automatic retries, splitting a run for rework, and how customers are told about capture problems.

roles.note: Recovery actions are taken by Track3D staff in Antman or by Antman itself. Customers don't start retries in the traced code.

actions.action: Cancel a running stitching or processing run
Create a rework split of a run
Send a customer an email about capture issues

nfr.statement: Airflow retries download and upload steps three times and stitching twice; a virtual machine that fails to start is requeued for scheduled jobs. There is no retry limit for the whole job in the traced code.
nfr.open_question: What share of captures may fail processing, and how fast must a failed capture be retried or the customer told (DEC-054, DEC-055)?

requirements.title: The pipeline's last step reports success or failure, and failures are final for that run
requirements.statement: A run finishes when its last step (the emailer or person-blur step) reports a final event. The outcome is the pipeline status it reports; (Current behaviour) if none is reported, it counts as passed. A failed stitching or processing run, a failed verification and a rejected sign-off are final: that run can't change status again, and any rework needs a new run.

requirements.title: Operators can escalate a run to the ML team
requirements.statement: An operator can escalate a run that is in stitching, processing or a review step to the ML team with notes and failure reasons. The run becomes inactive, the escalation is logged, and the configured ML recipients are emailed when the email settings exist.

requirements.title: (Current behaviour) Cancelling a run only changes Antman's record
requirements.statement: A run can be cancelled only while it is in stitching or in processing. Cancelling marks it inactive and logs who did it. It doesn't stop the Airflow run or the virtual machine, so compute may keep running.

requirements.title: A scheduled job whose machine fails to start is retried; a manual job is not
requirements.statement: If the virtual machine for a run can't be created, the run is marked failed. For jobs that came through the scheduled queues, Antman adds a new pending queue row and a replacement run. Jobs started manually are only marked failed. When the cloud zone is out of resources it is avoided for a while.

requirements.title: An operator can split a run into a new run for review
requirements.statement: An operator can create a split from a run, including an inactive one. The split is a new run for the same job, linked to its parent, numbered in order and waiting for point-cloud verification. It keeps the parent's automatic-registration setting.

requirements.title: Categorised issue emails tell customers about capture problems
requirements.statement: Internal teams can select categorised issues with uploaded sheets, BIM or captures and send one email from Track3D support listing them, with help articles. Customer support can see a summary of every email sent.
